text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature has publicly declared her intention to defeat Tokai Teio at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's surprised to learn that Matikanetannhauser is entering too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They promise to each give it their all no matter what happens, and the Arima Kinen begins!
